decision: Decide whether AS-qualified selects must be held through the data phase
options: Use AS-qualified decode directly; latch selected range through DS; decode without AS
notes: New_Address_Decode.dig test cases force selects inactive when AS is low

decision: Confirm physical gate packing for generic gates in New_Address_Decode.dig
options: Current staged 7408 7411 7432 7404 mapping; alternate NAND NOR packing; PAL implementation
notes: The design file names logical gates while the CSV now stages one conservative TTL implementation

decision: Confirm the mapping of MC14411 F1 F3 F8 F9 to 74153 C0 C1 C2 C3
options: F1/F3/F8/F9 in ascending input order; alternate order for chosen reset baud rate
notes: Staged connections use F1->C0 F3->C1 F8->C2 F9->C3 provisionally

decision: Choose source for the 74153 select inputs
options: DIP switch; 7474 register; I2C GPIO expander; CPU port
notes: Connections currently stage only the U4 select pins on BAUD_SEL_A and BAUD_SEL_B

decision: Keep the 5 MHz crystal loop local to the CPU
options: Place Y1 C5 C6 and R5 close to U1 pins 39 and 38; do not hang other loads on OSC2; observe clock only through a buffer or later test pad
notes: Raw oscillator nodes should not be used as general board clocks

decision: Confirm CPU crystal load capacitor values
options: 18 pF NP0/C0G initial build value; adjust within COSC1 15-30 pF and COSC2 15-25 pF datasheet ranges; tune for selected crystal load capacitance
notes: C5 and C6 stage the shared-chat 18 pF start value

decision: Decide whether LI should get a debug test pad
options: Add LI test pad after pin and symbol are verified; expose LI only on a future debug header; omit LI
notes: Shared chat called out LI for debug visibility but LI is not present in the staged CPU symbol rows yet

decision: Observe only a buffered system clock and not raw oscillator nodes
options: Add a SYSCLK buffer source; use an existing buffered clock if available; omit clock pad
notes: TP8 stages the observation endpoint only; do not attach TP8 to CPU_OSC1 or CPU_OSC2

decision: Stage first-revision bring-up test pads
options: Power rails; reset; shared IRQ; AS DS R/~W; buffered SYSCLK endpoint; ROM RAM ACIA RTC selects; ACIA TTL serial; RTC timing strobes and BUSY
notes: Test pads are represented as explicit components so the KiCad import can place them

decision: Use J3 as the Port A and Port B GPIO breakout
notes: Port B labels appear on the header while the canonical staged nets remain D0-D7 because PB is multiplexed with the external bus

decision: Choose the exact J3 mechanical footprint
options: Right-angle 2x10 0.1 inch header; boxed or shrouded IDC if board space allows; unshrouded right-angle header
notes: J3 is staged with an IDC-style horizontal footprint as a starting point but the exact connector remains a layout decision

decision: Omit the PA0 activity LED network
options: No PA0 jumper LED or 1 kohm resistor staged in this slice
notes: Current user direction supersedes the shared-chat optional PA0 activity LED proposal

decision: Omit priority encoder hardware in the first revision
options: Firmware polls device status; add hardware prioritization later only if needed
notes: Shared line source identification is handled in firmware

decision: Choose exact IRQ pull-up value
options: 4.7 kohm; 10 kohm
notes: R8 stages the shared-chat 4.7-10 kohm range for the wire-OR IRQ line

decision: Require conversion before push-pull interrupt sources join IRQ
options: Open-collector transistor; open-drain gate; diode/transistor isolation
notes: Only open-drain/open-collector outputs can directly wire-OR onto IRQ

decision: Decide whether MSM58321 BUSY should join IRQ
options: Leave RTC_BUSY separate; tie RTC_BUSY into IRQ; expose RTC_BUSY only on a test pad
notes: MSM58321 has no normal interrupt output; BUSY is open-drain but should join IRQ only by deliberate design choice

decision: Use one shared active-low IRQ line with open-drain sources
options: MC6850 direct; MSM58321 BUSY only if explicitly selected; future push-pull sources need local open-drain conversion
notes: R8 pulls IRQ to 5V0 and firmware polls status to identify the source

decision: Define the logic that drives ~MEMRD and ~RAMWE from DS and R/~W
options: Gate with DS and R/~W; derive from existing address-decode logic
notes: ROM and RAM output enables plus RAM write enables are staged on placeholder control nets

decision: Decide whether reset needs brownout supervision
options: Initial RC reset only; add voltage supervisor; add 7414-buffered RC cleanup
notes: CPU internal POR delay is for power-up only and should not be treated as brownout protection

decision: Confirm reset hold time against crystal startup
options: 10 ms RC initial value; increase RC toward 100 ms; use reset supervisor
notes: R4 and C4 stage the shared-chat 10 ms RC value while 5 MHz crystal startup may take about 100 ms

decision: Choose final reset circuit topology
options: Simple RC to Schmitt RESET input; RC plus 1N4148 discharge diode; RC through two 7414 Schmitt inverter sections
notes: R4 C4 and SW1 implement the simple RC reset; D2 is staged optional and no 7414 component is staged yet

decision: Decide whether RTC ADDRESS_WRITE READ and WRITE pulses need stretching
options: Direct AS/DS control; pulse-stretching glue
notes: RTC WRITE minimum is longer than the currently evaluated DS phase

decision: Choose exact 32.768 kHz RTC crystal package and part
options: Crystal impedance no more than 30 kohm; through-hole watch crystal; compact tuning-fork SMD crystal
notes: Y3 remains generic until the package and supplier part are selected

decision: Confirm RTC oscillator load network
options: 18 pF NP0/C0G load capacitors plus 10 Mohm feedback; optional trimmer on XT; adjust for selected crystal load capacitance
notes: C7 C8 R6 and optional C9 stage the shared-chat starting network

decision: Define RTC interface behavior while main logic power is absent
options: Hold RTC chip selects inactive; isolate data and control bus with glue; rely on main-rail pull-ups and inactive CPU
notes: The backed-up RTC supply must not let an unpowered logic bus drive or corrupt the RTC interface

decision: Use battery-backed RTC supply
options: Direct 5V0 rejected; CR2032 plus 5V0 diode-OR into RTC_VDD
notes: RTC_VDD is now staged from Schottky-isolated 5V0 and CR2032 feeds

decision: Keep RTC interface pull-ups on the main logic rail
options: Use 5V0 for RTC data/control pull-ups; do not pull interface lines to RTC_VDD
notes: The battery-backed rail should preserve timekeeping only and not back-power logic interfaces

decision: Define glue that drives RTC_SELECT for the complete bus cycle
options: Unqualified decode; latch AS-qualified RTCCS through data phase
notes: Current RTCCS proves the address range but drops before DS

decision: Decide STOP and BUSY handling
options: Tie STOP low and leave BUSY unconsumed; expose BUSY with pull-up; control STOP from glue or port
notes: STOP and BUSY are staged on todo nets

decision: Resolve MC14411 rate range for 9600 baud default
options: Shared chat X16 with F1 at 153.6 kHz and MC6850 divide-by-16; current design/baud-rate.md X64 with F1 at 614.4 kHz and MC6850 divide-by-64
notes: Preserve existing 74153 mux and X64 wiring until this conflict is resolved

decision: Choose final baud mux select source
options: DIP switch; 7474 register; I2C GPIO expander; CPU port
notes: Existing BAUD_SEL_A and BAUD_SEL_B remain todo

decision: Stage baseline console settings
options: 9600 baud 8N1; MC6850 divide-by-16 per shared chat; MC6850 divide-by-64 per current baud-rate.md X64 staging
notes: Shared chat calls out 9600 8N1 while existing baud-rate staging reaches 9600 through F1 and MC6850 divide-by-64

decision: Choose final DE-9 connector gender footprint and handshake exposure
options: DTE-style male DE-9; board-edge right-angle DE-9; expose handshake pins on header or leave NC
notes: J2 stages DTE-style TX pin 3 RX pin 2 and GND pin 5 with no-flow-control handshake pins NC

decision: Choose exact MAX232-family variant and charge-pump capacitor values
options: Classic MAX232 with larger charge-pump capacitors; MAX232A-class with 0.1 uF capacitors; inventory MAX232 part
notes: C12-C15 are staged as variant-dependent pending final datasheet

decision: Use no hardware flow control for baseline console
options: Tie CTS low; tie DCD low; leave RTS NC or test pad
notes: U2 CTS and DCD are tied low while RTS is staged NC

decision: Keep SYSCLK off the TIMER header
options: No SYSCLK on TIMER header; separate SYSCLK test pad only; future buffered clock source still TBD
notes: Direct SYSCLK to TIMER loopback is not useful at CPU clock frequency and raw oscillator nodes must not be exposed

decision: Use TIMER header for external slow timer injection
options: External slow source into TIMER; no off-board bus assumptions
notes: J4 exposes TIMER GND and optional IRQ only

decision: Use a small three-pin TIMER IRQ GND service header
options: TIMER on pin 1; IRQ on pin 2; GND on pin 3
notes: J4 stages optional IRQ access beyond the shared test pad while keeping off-board assumptions minimal

decision: Terminate USB-C configuration pins for a non-PD sink
options: CC1 has independent 5.1 kohm Rd to GND; CC2 or VCONN has independent 5.1 kohm Rd to GND; do not tie CC pins together; do not source VCONN
notes: R1 and R2 stage separate Rd pull-downs for orientation detection without USB-PD

decision: Choose the exact USB-C receptacle footprint
options: Through-hole power-only connector; SMD connector; breakout-compatible footprint
notes: J1 is staged generically; full footprint pins include explicit NCs for D+/D- SuperSpeed and SBU; CC2 may be labeled VCONN on simplified symbols

decision: Choose the protected rail input bulk capacitance
options: 10 uF; 22 uF; 47 uF
notes: C1 is staged as 10-47 uF pending final value and footprint

decision: Decide whether to add an input power switch
options: No switch; switch after PPTC on protected 5V0; switch before PPTC on USB_VBUS
notes: The shared chat listed a power switch as optional; no switch component is staged yet

decision: Choose the exact USB input resettable fuse
options: 1.1 A hold ~2.2 A trip >=6 V preferably 16 V SMD 1812 JLCPCB-assembled; 1210 acceptable; MF-R110-class radial 5.08 mm; 1.5 A hold if external loads grow
notes: F1 is staged generically as a PPTC between raw USB_VBUS and protected 5V0; avoid 0805 for 1.1 A class

decision: Choose USB connector shield grounding
options: Direct to GND; 1 nF to GND; 1 Mohm parallel 1 nF to GND
notes: Shared chat prefers 1 nF and optionally parallel 1 Mohm; avoid floating shield; R3 and C3 are staged as optional shield components

decision: Specify expected external USB-C supply rating
options: Dedicated 5 V supply rated at least 1.5 A; preferably 3 A; lower-current supplies not recommended
notes: Power-only non-PD USB-C uses advertised default current without negotiation

decision: Choose final vendor and package for the 5 V VBUS TVS
options: SMBJ5.0A preferred; SMAJ5.0A smaller lower-surge option; other reputable 5.0 V unidirectional TVS
notes: D1 is staged as SMBJ5.0A-class with cathode stripe to USB_VBUS and anode to GND on the connector side of the fuse

decision: Treat unused USB-C pins for power-only operation
options: D+/D- NC; SuperSpeed pairs NC; SBU1/SBU2 NC
notes: J1 stages explicit NC rows for full USB-C footprints; no USB data ESD array is staged because data pins are unused
